description: Negative: a cluster with two broader values breaks the mono-parent tree. The schema also refuses it through maxItems on the cluster branch, but the reported code is the specific AGSC-E308, not the generic schema failure, per the precedence rule of spec/09 section 9.4. Parents are named in code-point order.

items.description: One of the two parents this vector attaches a child to.
The other parent, which makes the child mono-parent no more.
A child cluster that wrongly claims two parent clusters.
